acceptance_criteria: AC1: All six #4762 cards are issue-specific and state preparation-only truth.
AC2: The design and diagram name exact current source dependencies and distinguish execution-time witness/receipt creation from this preparation branch.
AC3: Intended later execution paths are exact, issue-local, and milestone-consumable.
AC4: COTS/external-service posture, LoC/time/token budgets, PVF lanes, rollback criteria, and no-deferral criteria are explicit.
AC5: Claim reacquisition, terminal receipts, PR publication, merge, and closeout are deferred to execution/finish and do not block preparation.
AC6: One bounded preparation review is retained and all actionable preparation-scope findings are fixed or recorded as blockers.
AC7: Local preparation validation records diff hygiene, card-surface integrity, and the expected claim_not_live doctor blocker without reacquiring the claim.
